decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template builds directly on the firm's shop hosting know-how, and the agency customer base lets it judge demand, though templates are minor items that may quietly disappear from the website.
The responsive template sits close to existing CMS hosting expertise and costs little to maintain, but it is only mentioned in passing and is easily replaced or removed.
Premium support extends the firm's core round-the-clock expert support, so it fits existing capabilities well and the firm can readily learn from customer uptake.
The version management tool builds on the firm's own software development and its management tools that cut operational work, and it is presented on a dedicated page, signalling commitment.

The GDPR contract tool is distant from the hosting knowledge base, which limits absorptive capacity, but it meets a real legal need for agencies and has its own page, so the firm keeps it for now with a high risk of discontinuation.
